annotations.title: Lay out Playground media for comparison

description: Compare 2–4 images or 2–4 videos side by side on the canvas. Two images fill a Compare (image-compare) node's A/B slots; three or four images feed a Picks (output-gallery) node; videos are grouped in one titled row. Inputs stay where they are except videos, which move into the new group. Free; revision checked and idempotent. It does not judge quality. Returns comparison layout, selected node IDs, summaries, revision and Playground URL.

expectedRevision.description: Current canvas revision from canvas_read; on revision_conflict, read again and rebuild the change.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this request; reuse only when retrying the identical request after a lost response. Use a new key after quoting or changing inputs.

nodeIds.description: IDs of the existing canvas nodes to use for this action.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

title.description: Human-readable label to display for this item in Playground.
